def number_to_string(number, significant_digits, number_format_notation='f'):
    if number_format_notation not in number_formatting:
        raise ValueError(f"number_format_notation must be one of {list(number_formatting.keys())}, got {number_format_notation}")
    
    if isinstance(number, complex):
        # Handle complex numbers by formatting real and imaginary parts separately
        real_str = number_to_string(number.real, significant_digits, number_format_notation)
        imag_str = number_to_string(number.imag, significant_digits, number_format_notation)
        
        # Parse the formatted strings back to floats to reconstruct complex number
        real_val = float(real_str)
        imag_val = float(imag_str)
        result_complex = complex(real_val, imag_val)
        
        # Format the complex number
        format_str = number_formatting[number_format_notation]
        precision = significant_digits
        
        if number_format_notation == 'f':
            return f'{result_complex.real:.{precision}f}{result_complex.imag:+.{precision}f}j'
        else:  # 'e'
            return f'{result_complex.real:.{precision}e}{result_complex.imag:+.{precision}e}j'
    
    # Handle regular numbers (int, float, Decimal)
    format_str = number_formatting[number_format_notation]
    format_template = format_str.replace('%s', str(significant_digits))
    
    # Convert to float if needed
    if isinstance(number, Decimal):
        number = float(number)
    
    result = format_template.format(number)
    return result
